meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你为某个渠道创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体:确认你的渠道身份、把私聊消息组接到新智能体,并让智能体通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私聊。重复运行是安全的。
howto.when: 前提是渠道凭据已配置、服务正在运行;当你需要给某个已启用的渠道初始化第一个智能体并验证私聊投递时触发。

say.text: 帮我为 Discord 渠道初始化第一个 NanoClaw 智能体
say.note: 它会先问你的渠道用户 ID 和显示名

say.text: 用我的 Telegram ID 给这个渠道接一个智能体
say.note: 它会解析私聊平台 ID 再跑初始化脚本

say.text: 欢迎私聊没收到,帮我排查一下
say.note: 它会查 outbound.db 和日志定位问题

howto.what_en: After install, Claude walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a channel: it resolves your channel identity, wires the DM messaging group to a new agent, and has the agent send a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Reruns are safe.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you want to set up the first agent for an enabled channel.

say_en.text: Set up the first NanoClaw agent for my Discord channel
say_en.note: It first asks for your channel user ID and display name

say_en.text: Wire an agent to this channel using my Telegram ID
say_en.note: It resolves the DM platform ID, then runs the init script

say_en.text: I didn't get the welcome DM, help me debug
say_en.note: It checks outbound.db and logs to locate the issue
